title: 第5章 魔威一百遍啊一百遍第6章 迫不及待的小师妹
slug: 重生魔帝开局骗女帝下界双修
content_zh:
密室之内。
石壁之中鹅蛋大的夜明珠映得四壁生辉。
但是却掩不住那股浓重的气味与压抑的气息。
女帝祖师姬曦瑶半倚在白玉软床上。
她身上满是凌乱的痕迹。
只见她雪白的肌肤上红痕交错。
汗渍未干，仿佛冒着香气。
那是被林云留下的杰作。
由于次数太多，强度太高，此刻她呼吸未平，胸口微微起伏。
白嫩的脸上写满了屈辱与愤怒。
还有一丝绝美的潮红余韵。
姬曦瑶用纤细的手指颤抖着撑起身子，缓了好一会儿，才勉强坐直。
散落一地的纱裙，和金黄色的龙纹肚兜在夜明珠下泛着微光。
她咬着牙，强忍着浑身的无力感，俯身捡起那件薄如蝉翼的衣裙。
手指触碰到衣裙时明显一抖，眼底恨意一闪而过。
肚兜被她攥得指节发白，随后她低头默默穿上，动作缓慢却透着一股倔强。
随后把纱裙披上身，遮住了那曼妙的身段。
依然魅力无双。
可那股从骨子里透出的冷艳与杀意，却是怎么也掩不住。
而且她现在也想起了一个很重要的问题。

自己被那个畜生这么多次。
但是修为被完全封印了，就连储物空间都打不开。
姬曦瑶微微闭着眼睛，心中有些疑虑。
她好看的眉头皱了起来。
要是万一.....
那就到时候把生命种子封印起来再考虑吧。
自己是绝对不会生下那个畜生的孩子的。
姬曦瑶开始闭目调息起来，但是体内的情况让她绝望。
根本调动不了丝毫法力。
而另一边，林云却是春风满面。
这家伙站在密室外的石台上，闭目感受着体内那股翻江倒海的法力。
飞升境界，天下之巅！
那些圣地的老怪物或许也能摸到这门槛。
但是那些不敢渡劫的老不死哪里比得上英明神武的自己？
他嘴角一咧，露出一抹得意的笑。
明天，九大仙宗的联军就要杀到阴阳圣宗门前。
那些自诩正道的家伙一口一个“魔宗”，恨不得把他连根拔起。
可惜，他们做梦也想不到，他已今非昔比。
林云眯起眼，暗暗压下体内那股磅礴的气息，打算给那群仙宗崽子一个大惊喜。
甚至到时候直接引下天劫，让他们全部灰飞烟灭。

念头一转，他身形一闪，直奔宗门大殿。
一路遇见的漂亮女仆和亲传弟子看见林老魔都是战战兢兢的躬身行礼。
“见过掌教至尊！”他们恨不得把头低到地面上去。
content_en:
Within the secret room.
The goose egg-sized luminous pearls in the stone wall reflect the surrounding walls.
But he couldn't hide the strong smell and depressing atmosphere.
Ji Xiyao, the ancestor of the empress, was half leaning on the soft white jade bed.
There were messy marks all over her body.
I saw red marks crisscrossing her snow-white skin.
The sweat stains are not yet dry, and they seem to smell fragrant.
That was a masterpiece left by Lin Yun.
Because there were too many times and the intensity was too high, her breathing was still uneven and her chest was rising and falling slightly.
The white and tender face was filled with humiliation and anger.
There's also a nice flushy finish.
Ji Xiyao used trembling slender fingers to prop herself up, and after a while, she managed to sit upright.
The gauze skirts scattered on the floor and the golden dragon-patterned bellyband shimmered under the night pearls.
She gritted her teeth, suppressed the feeling of powerlessness all over her body, and leaned down to pick up the dress as thin as cicada wings.
When his fingers touched the dress, he trembled obviously, and hatred flashed in his eyes.
She clutched the belly band until her knuckles turned white, then she lowered her head and put it on silently, her movements slow but revealing a hint of stubbornness.
Then she put her gauze skirt on her body, covering her graceful figure.
Still unrivaled in charm.
But the cold glamor and murderous intent coming from his bones could not be concealed at all costs.
And now she also remembered a very important question.
I was beaten by that beast so many times.
But the cultivation level was completely sealed, and even the storage space could not be opened.
Ji Xiyao closed her eyes slightly, with some doubts in her heart.
Her pretty brows wrinkled.
Just in case...
Then let’s seal the life seeds and think about it later.
I would never give birth to that beast's child.
Ji Xiyao began to close her eyes and regulate her breathing, but the condition inside her body made her despair.
There is no way to mobilize any mana at all.
On the other side, Lin Yun's face was full of spring breeze.
This guy stood on the stone platform outside the secret room, closing his eyes and feeling the overwhelming mana in his body.
Ascend to the realm, the top of the world!
Those old monsters in the Holy Land may also be able to touch this threshold.
But how can those old immortals who dare not overcome the calamity compare to the wise and powerful themselves?
He twisted his lips into a proud smile.
Tomorrow, the allied forces of the Nine Immortal Sects will fight in front of the Yin Yang Holy Sect.
Those self-proclaimed righteous guys call him a "devil sect" and want to uproot him.
Unfortunately, they never dreamed that he was no longer what he used to be.
Lin Yun narrowed his eyes and secretly suppressed the majestic aura in his body, planning to give those Immortal Sect brats a big surprise.
Even when the time comes, it will directly trigger a catastrophe and make them all disappear into ashes.
As soon as his thoughts changed, he flashed and ran straight to the sect's main hall.
The beautiful maids and direct disciples who met along the way bowed timidly when they saw Old Demon Lin.
"I've seen the Supreme Leader!" They wanted to lower their heads to the ground.
